mapper.sql: a.apr17_corp_doc_id AS corp_doc_id , a.apr17_call_date AS call_date , a.apr17_reg_date AS reg_date , a.apr17_stamp_cert_issue_cnt AS stamp_cert_issue_cnt , a.apr17_stamp_cert_call_cnt AS stamp_cert_call_cnt , a.apr17_stamp_cert_use_cnt AS stamp_cert_use_cnt , a.apr17_corp_reg_issue_cnt AS corp_reg_issue_cnt , a.apr17_corp_reg_call_cnt AS corp_reg_call_cnt , a.apr17_corp_reg_use_cnt AS corp_reg_use_cnt , a.apr17_provide_co AS provide_co , a.apr17_purpose AS purpose , a.apr17_requester AS requester , a.apr17_note AS note , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr17_call_emp_id) AS call_emp_name , ( SELECT count(*) FROM apr18_relate_corp_doc INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = apr18_appr_id WHERE apr18_corp_doc_id = a.apr17_corp_doc_id ) || ' 건' AS appr_cnt_str , EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM apr19_relate_stamp WHERE apr19_corp_doc_id = a.apr17_corp_doc_id AND apr19_stamp_date IS NOT NULL ) AS stamp_date_yn
mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY type_nm DESC) AS id , type_nm AS type_name , issue_sum , use_sum , remain FROM ( SELECT '법인인감증명서' AS type_nm , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_stamp_cert_issue_cnt), 0) AS issue_sum , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_stamp_cert_use_cnt), 0) AS use_sum , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_stamp_cert_issue_cnt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(apr17_stamp_cert_use_cnt), 0) AS remain FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} UNION ALL SELECT '법인등기부등본' AS type_nm , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_corp_reg_issue_cnt), 0) AS issue_sum , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_corp_reg_use_cnt), 0) AS use_sum , COALESCE(SUM(apr17_corp_reg_issue_cnt), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(apr17_corp_reg_use_cnt), 0) AS remain FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY type_nm DESC
mapper.sql: s.apr19_relate_stamp_id AS relate_stamp_id , s.apr19_corp_doc_id AS corp_doc_id , s.apr19_stamp_id AS stamp_id , ( SELECT apr10_stamp_nm FROM apr10_stamp WHERE apr10_stamp_id = s.apr19_stamp_id ) AS stamp_name , s.apr19_stamp_cnt AS stamp_cnt , COALESCE(s.apr19_out_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS out_yn , s.apr19_stamp_date AS stamp_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apr19_relate_stamp WHERE apr19_corp_doc_id IN ( SELECT apr17_corp_doc_id FROM apr17_corp_doc WHERE apr17_company_id = #{companyId} ) AND apr19_relate_stamp_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_long01, sys99_long02, sys99_long03, sys99_long04, sys99_long05, sys99_long06 , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , #{row.regDate}, COALESCE(#{row.stampCertIssueCnt}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.stampCertCallCnt}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.stampCertUseCnt}, 0) , COALESCE(#{row.corpRegIssueCnt}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.corpRegCallCnt}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.corpRegUseCnt}, 0) , COALESCE(#{row.provideCo}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.purpose}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.requester}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.note}, '') )
